scenes.title: The manor at midnight
scenes.storyBeat: A couple approaches a haunted manor, with two figures watching from an upstairs window.

scenes.title: Footsteps with no owner
scenes.storyBeat: Ghostly traces lead the couple deeper into the house.

scenes.title: The ghosts in the ballroom
scenes.storyBeat: Two spirits appear as if waiting for their last dance.

scenes.title: Stay close to me
scenes.storyBeat: They steady each other and choose to face the mystery together.

scenes.title: The haunted waltz
scenes.storyBeat: The living couple joins the spirits for a final waltz.

scenes.title: Until the last candle
scenes.storyBeat: At dawn, they leave with a memory only the two of them understand.

htmlContent.opening: Hold my hand. Let’s see what’s waiting.
htmlContent.message: Whatever waits in the dark, I want you beside me.
htmlContent.finalQuestion: What should our next spooky night be?
